services.name: Kayak rental
services.desc: We have single and tandem kayaks available for your enjoyment. We have a variety of sizes and lengths with the maximum weight capacity of a single 375lbs & tandem 500lbs. We have an automatic lift to ease the vessel in and out of the water. Hop in the kayak and enjoy the warm sun and gentle breezes from a new vantage point. All kayaks are beginner friendly, come with safety equipment, PFD, and a safety lesson. We have a 17ft aluminum Smokercraft canoe which can accommodate 2 adults and 2 children. We have 2 pedal boats available for your riding pleasure. It is able to accommodate 2 adults and 2 small children. Weight capacity

blurb: Guests can rent SUP boards, kayaks, canoes, pedal boats, and inflatable boats to paddle along the Belle River or lake shoreline. All rentals include safety equipment and a safety lesson. SUP yoga, fitness, and paddling classes are available by reservation.
extraNote: Weekday rental additional hours $10, weekend additional hours $15 for SUP and kayaks · Weekday additional hour $15 for canoe and tandem kayaks, weekend $15 · Classes only run if reservations have been made · If you want to rent or schedule an event outside of hours, call to make arrangements · Belle River Yacht Club, 193 West River Rd, Belle River, Ontario · May long weekend through August
